snippet.title: Quatiica Motorsports | Official Cinematic Teaser
snippet.description:
A brighter future. Where racing is still celebrated. Built to change the world.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5059170/Quatiica_Motorsports/

Quatiica Motorsports is an anti-gravity racing game set in 2096, developed by Quatiica Studios.

This is a cinematic production, not actual gameplay. Rendered in Blender and Unreal Engine. No generative AI involved.

Support us on Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/cw/QuatiicaMotorsports
Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/CabQH9zVDk
Website: https://www.quatiica.com/

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/quatiica/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@quatiica
X: https://x.com/quatiica
